title: Fixed Wheeled Auger Snow Machine
description: One newly authored complete fixed walk-behind snow-machine appearance under the original winter snow-clearing tool direction. Whole open-front intake casing has two opposed broad helical flights on a transverse shaft and a true top port into a thick bent through-open discharge chute. Rear motor-shaped enclosure, paired finite-facet wheels, broad front skids, long push arms and empty control bridge form one supported machine. No old soil auger, mine fan or twin-roll crusher geometry is imported or repositioned. One model, zero scenes. Static exposed visual geometry only: no motor, rotation, snow flow, clearing performance, discharge reach, guarded operation, manoeuvrability, ergonomic, structural, manufacturing or safety claim; not instructions or a safe operating design.
